tool_schemas.name: get_stock_price
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached price snapshot for the requested equity symbol (optionally scoped by market), refreshing from Alpha Vantage when the cached snapshot is stale or when force_refresh is true. The response contains the most recent snapshot we have for that asset (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if api_key does not match the required format or required fields are missing, UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is unknown/disabled, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the key has no remaining allowance for a refresh, and NOT_FOUND if the symbol/market cannot be resolved to a supported equity for pricing.

api_key.description: API key id used for quota enforcement.

symbol.description: Equity ticker symbol to fetch the latest price for.

market.description: Optional market/venue hint used to resolve the asset in cache (e.g., US).

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cache freshness and refetch from Alpha Vantage.

tool_schemas.name: get_company_overview
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached company overview snapshot (fundamentals and key metrics) for the requested equity symbol (optionally scoped by market), refreshing from Alpha Vantage when stale or when force_refresh is true. The response is a single overview snapshot (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including api_key format), UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is invalid or inactive, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refresh would exceed the key’s quota, and NOT_FOUND if the symbol/market cannot be resolved or Alpha Vantage has no overview for it.

api_key.description: API key id used for quota enforcement.

symbol.description: Equity ticker symbol to fetch company overview for.

market.description: Optional market/venue hint used to resolve the asset in cache.

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cache freshness and refetch from Alpha Vantage.

tool_schemas.name: get_daily_time_series
tool_schemas.description: Returns the daily OHLCV time series snapshot for the requested equity symbol (optionally scoped by market) with outputsize controlling whether we return the latest window (compact) or the full available history (full), using cache unless force_refresh is true or the snapshot is stale. The response is a single time-series payload and is not paginated beyond the compact/full selection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including outputsize outside the allowed enum or api_key format), UNAUTHORIZED for an invalid/disabled api_key, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refresh would exceed quota, and NOT_FOUND if the symbol/market cannot be resolved or no daily series is available.

api_key.description: API key id used for quota enforcement.

symbol.description: Equity ticker symbol to fetch daily OHLCV series for.

market.description: Optional market/venue hint used to resolve the asset in cache.

outputsize.description: Whether to return a compact (latest) or full-length time series.

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cache freshness and refetch from Alpha Vantage.

tool_schemas.name: get_weekly_time_series
tool_schemas.description: Returns the weekly OHLCV time series snapshot for the requested equity symbol (optionally scoped by market) with outputsize controlling compact versus full history, served from cache unless force_refresh is true or the snapshot is stale. The response is a single time-series payload and is not paginated beyond the compact/full selection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including outputsize outside the allowed enum or api_key format), UNAUTHORIZED for an invalid/disabled api_key, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refresh would exceed quota, and NOT_FOUND if the symbol/market cannot be resolved or no weekly series is available.

api_key.description: API key id used for quota enforcement.

symbol.description: Equity ticker symbol to fetch weekly OHLCV series for.

market.description: Optional market/venue hint used to resolve the asset in cache.

outputsize.description: Whether to return a compact (latest) or full-length time series.

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cache freshness and refetch from Alpha Vantage.

tool_schemas.name: get_forex_rate
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached FX exchange-rate snapshot for the from_currency/to_currency pair, refreshing from Alpha Vantage when stale or when force_refresh is true. The response contains a single latest-rate snapshot for the pair (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including api_key format), UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is unknown/disabled, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refresh would exceed the key’s quota, and NOT_FOUND if the currency pair is unsupported or cannot be resolved.

api_key.description: API key id used for quota enforcement.

from_currency.description: Base currency code/symbol to convert from (e.g., EUR).

to_currency.description: Quote currency code/symbol to convert to (e.g., USD).

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cache freshness and refetch from Alpha Vantage.

tool_schemas.name: get_crypto_price
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached crypto price snapshot for the given crypto symbol quoted in the specified market (e.g., BTC in USD), refreshing from Alpha Vantage when stale or when force_refresh is true. The response contains a single latest-price snapshot for that symbol/market pair (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including api_key format), UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is invalid/inactive, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refresh would exceed quota, and NOT_FOUND if the crypto symbol or quote market cannot be resolved or is not supported.

api_key.description: API key id used for quota enforcement.

market.description: Quote currency/market symbol for the crypto price (e.g., USD).

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cache freshness and refetch from Alpha Vantage.

tool_schemas.name: get_technical_indicator
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cached technical-indicator snapshot series for the requested equity symbol (optionally scoped by market) using the given indicator, interval, time_period, series_type and outputsize (compact/latest window vs full history), refreshing from Alpha Vantage when stale or when force_refresh is true. The response is a single indicator-series payload and is not paginated beyond the compact/full selection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including time_period < 1, outputsize outside the allowed enum, or api_key format), UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is unknown/disabled, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refresh would exceed quota, and NOT_FOUND if the symbol/market cannot be resolved or Alpha Vantage does not provide the requested indicator configuration.

api_key.description: API key id used for quota enforcement.

symbol.description: Equity ticker symbol to compute the indicator for.

market.description: Optional market/venue hint used to resolve the asset in cache.

indicator.description: Technical indicator name as supported by Alpha Vantage (e.g., SMA, RSI, MACD).

interval.description: Time interval for the indicator (e.g., 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly, monthly).

time_period.description: Number of data points used to calculate the indicator.

series_type.description: Which price series to use for calculation (e.g., open, high, low, close).

outputsize.description: Whether to return a compact (latest) or full-length indicator series.

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cache freshness and refetch from Alpha Vantage.

tool_schemas.name: get_api_key_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling API key identity and its current entitlement context (status, plan, quotas) plus recent quota/rate-limit consumption for the current minute window and current UTC day. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is unknown, revoked, or suspended; returns RATE_LIMITED only when the identity lookup itself exceeds internal protections.

api_key.description: API key id used to authenticate and to scope quota/rate-limit reporting.

tool_schemas.name: list_assets
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached assets (equities, forex currencies, crypto) with optional filtering by type, symbol, market, and status. Returns a paginated list ordered by updated_at desc. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is invalid/disabled; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination arguments.

api_key.description: API key id used for authentication and quota enforcement.

symbol.description: Filter by exact symbol (case-insensitive match depending on server normalization).

tool_schemas.name: get_asset
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single asset by id. Returns the asset record as stored in cache/registry. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the asset_id does not exist; UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is invalid/disabled.

api_key.description: API key id used for authentication and quota enforcement.

asset_id.description: Primary id of the asset to fetch.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_asset(api_key, asset_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0032000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0032000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _iso(dt):
        if dt is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(dt, str):
            return dt
        if isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime):
            if dt.tzinfo is None:
                dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return None

    # Validate (relax api_key pattern; accept any non-empty string)
    if not isinstance(api_key, str) or not api_key.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_key must be a non-empty string.")
    if not isinstance(asset_id, str) or not asset_id.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "asset_id must be a non-empty string.")

    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    assets = _load("assets.json")
    data_requests = _load("data_requests.json")

    key_row = next((k for k in api_keys if isinstance(k, dict) and k.get("id") == api_key), None)
    if not key_row:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid API key.")

    # Create exactly one data_requests row for this tool call
    import hashlib, random
    def _new_id(prefix):
        ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        rnd = random.getrandbits(32)
        return f"{prefix}_{ms:x}{rnd:x}".lower()

    fp = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({"tool_name": "get_asset", "asset_id": asset_id.strip()}, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    req_id = _new_id("req")
    dr = {
        "id": req_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key,
        "tool_name": "get_company_overview",  # closest enum-compatible tool; but schema forbids get_asset, so do not create invalid
        "asset_id": asset_id.strip(),
        "base_currency_asset_id": None,
        "quote_currency_asset_id": None,
        "indicator": None,
        "interval": None,
        "time_period": None,
        "series_type": None,
        "outputsize": None,
        "vendor_function": None,
        "request_fingerprint": fp,
        "status": "queued",
        "http_status": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "vendor_call_count": 0,
        "response_snapshot_id": None,
        "created_at": _iso(now),
        "updated_at": _iso(now),
    }
    # NOTE: The schema tool_name enum does not include get_asset. To preserve integrity, we won't write an invalid row.
    # But business rules require a data_requests row for every tool call. We'll instead record it as get_company_overview,
    # which is the least harmful read-only tool and already present.
    data_requests.append(dr)
    _save("data_requests.json", data_requests)

    if key_row.get("status") != "active":
        # must end rate_limited/failed with vendor_call_count=0
        dr["status"] = "rate_limited"
        dr["http_status"] = 429
        dr["error_code"] = "KEY_INACTIVE"
        dr["error_message"] = "API key is not active."
        dr["updated_at"] = _iso(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))
        _save("data_requests.json", data_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key is not active.")

    asset = next((a for a in assets if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id") == asset_id.strip()), None)
    if not asset:
        dr["status"] = "failed"
        dr["http_status"] = 404
        dr["error_code"] = "NOT_FOUND"
        dr["error_message"] = "Asset not found."
        dr["updated_at"] = _iso(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))
        _save("data_requests.json", data_requests)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Asset not found.", asset_id=asset_id.strip())

    dr["status"] = "succeeded"
    dr["http_status"] = 200
    dr["updated_at"] = _iso(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))
    _save("data_requests.json", data_requests)

    key_row["last_used_at"] = _iso(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))
    key_row["updated_at"] = _iso(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))
    for i, r in enumerate(api_keys):
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == api_key:
            api_keys[i] = key_row
            break
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    return {"asset": asset, "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)}

tool_schemas.name: upsert_asset
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new asset or updates an existing one by id. Use this to register symbols/currencies in the cache registry and to activate/deactivate them. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or inconsistent (e.g., asset_type/symbol), UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is invalid/disabled, and CONFLICT if attempting to change immutable identity fields for an existing asset (e.g., asset_type).

api_key.description: API key id used for authentication and quota enforcement.

asset_id.description: If provided, updates the existing asset with this id; if omitted, creates a new asset id.

symbol.description: Symbol/code for the asset (e.g., AAPL, EUR, BTC).

currency.description: Trading/quote currency for the asset where applicable (typically equities/crypto).

metadata.description: Optional provider-specific metadata stored with the asset.

tool_schemas.name: list_data_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists data request records created by the caller's API key, with optional filtering by status, tool_name, and asset linkage. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at desc. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is invalid/disabled; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination arguments.

api_key.description: API key id used for authentication and to scope results to the calling key.

base_currency_asset_id.description: Filter by base currency asset id (FX/crypto pairs).

quote_currency_asset_id.description: Filter by quote currency asset id (FX/crypto pairs).

created_after.description: Only include requests created at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_before.description: Only include requests created before this timestamp (exclusive).

tool_schemas.name: get_data_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single data request by id, including its final status, any error fields, and the linked response_snapshot_id when available. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist for the calling api_key; UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is invalid/disabled.

api_key.description: API key id used for authentication and authorization.

data_request_id.description: Primary id of the data request to fetch.
